title: Activate dedicated EPS bearer context request

entities.name: Activate dedicated EPS bearer context procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context for the UE.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: EMM message sent by the network to the UE to request activation of a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer for the dedicated bearer context activation.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the default bearer to which the dedicated bearer is linked.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifies the procedure transaction for the dedicated bearer activation.

entities.name: Activate dedicated EPS bearer context request message type
entities.description: Message type information element for the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

relations.description: The activate dedicated EPS bearer context procedure includes sending the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the message type information element.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the EPS bearer identity IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the linked EPS bearer identity IE.
The ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains the procedure transaction identity IE.
